rules.title: How to play
rules.who: This is Findo. She is hiding on every map.
rules.find.body: She is drawn like everyone else around her. Look for the brown braids, the yellow top and the violet skirt.
rules.move: Drag to move, pinch to zoom
rules.move.body: The maps are far bigger than the screen. On the later levels you will not find her without zooming in.
rules.wrong.body: Tapping the wrong person takes 15 points and 3 seconds off the clock.
rules.fast: The faster you find her, the better
rules.fast.body: Every second left on the clock is worth 10 points, and your total decides one to three stars.
rules.hint.body: A hint moves the map towards Findo and makes her glow. You start with three. Every 10 stars you collect earn another one free.
sheet.title: Look for her
chapter.1.name: Curious
chapter.1.blurb: Ten crowds behind you. You know her three marks by heart now -- brown braids, a yellow top with a black yoke, a violet skirt -- and from here on she stops making it easy.
chapter.2.name: Observer
chapter.2.blurb: She shrinks every level until she reaches a size she will never go below. And here come the first who look like her: two on every map, each wearing one of her marks.
chapter.3.name: Sentinel
chapter.3.blurb: The scenes start to move. Snow, bubbles, confetti. Everything that drifts pulls the eye -- and she is the only thing standing still.
chapter.4.name: Braid Hunter
chapter.4.blurb: You have stopped sweeping at random. Six impostors on every map, and some now carry two of her three marks. Hunting for yellow alone gets you caught here.
chapter.5.name: Crowd Reader
chapter.5.blurb: A crowd is not noise, it is structure. You know where people stand and where they only pass through, and she will not be there. Eight impostors, six hundred people.
chapter.6.name: Detective
chapter.6.blurb: Ten impostors, two of them sharing two marks out of three. They no longer fool you: you check the third before your finger comes down.
chapter.7.name: Quick Eye
chapter.7.blurb: Time is all that is left. She will not shrink further and the maps will not fill further -- only the clock tightens, and the time bonus is most of the score.
chapter.8.name: Hawk
chapter.8.blurb: Your hand is ahead of your reasoning. You tap before you have finished working out why, and you are right. Fourteen impostors among nine hundred people.
chapter.9.name: Marksman
chapter.9.blurb: She is not hiding from you any more, she is only buying seconds. The hiding place changes every attempt, and you reach all of them -- without one wasted tap.
chapter.10.name: All-Seeing
chapter.10.blurb: Forty-five seconds. Nine hundred people. Eighteen impostors, four of them nearly her. And the air is full of movement.
rank.locked: Keep playing to earn your first rank
finale.title: You found me everywhere
finale.body: A hundred levels, a hundred crowds, and you found me in every one of them. Thank you for looking.
finale.perfectBody: Not one star missed. There is nowhere left for me to hide.
daily.title: Daily Hunt
daily.intro.body: One level for every player today, at the hardest difficulty, with Findo waiting in the same place for everyone. Only your first try goes on the leaderboard, and there are no hints.
daily.result.officialMissed: That was today's official attempt. The next hunt opens in {time}.
daily.result.posted: Your time is on today's leaderboard.
daily.result.offline: Couldn't reach the leaderboard, so your time wasn't posted. Check your internet connection.
daily.done.body: You've played today. The next hunt opens in {time}, when the leaderboard turns over — so every time on the table belongs to the same hunt.
lb.title: Leaderboard
lb.empty: No times here yet. Be the first.
lb.signedOut: Couldn't connect to the leaderboard. Check your internet connection and try again.
lb.error: Couldn't load the leaderboard. Check your internet connection.
lb.unsupported: The leaderboard isn't available on this device.
tutorial.meet.title: Meet Findo
tutorial.meet.body: She is hiding somewhere on this map. Look for brown braids, a yellow top and a violet skirt. Tap her picture below any time to see her up close.
tutorial.drag.title: Drag to look around
tutorial.drag.body: The map is bigger than your screen. Slide one finger across it to move.
tutorial.zoom.title: Pinch to zoom in
tutorial.zoom.body: Spread two fingers apart to get closer to the crowd. On later levels you will need it.
tutorial.hint.title: Stuck? Try a hint
tutorial.hint.body: Tap the light bulb. A hint moves the map towards Findo and makes her glow. This one is free.
tutorial.find.title: Now tap her!
tutorial.find.body: Found her? Tap Findo to win. A wrong tap costs points and time, so look before you tap. The clock starts on the next level.
tip.misclick: That wasn't her: a wrong tap costs 15 points and 3 seconds. Check her three marks before you tap.
tip.timeBonus: From now on the clock is running. Every second left when you find her is worth 10 points, and more points mean more stars.
tip.character: Forgot what she looks like? Tap her picture in the bar below. The clock stops while you look.
tip.daily: New: the Daily Hunt on the home screen. One extra-hard level a day, the same for everyone, with a leaderboard.
tip.zoom: The crowds are getting bigger. Pinch to zoom in close and sweep the map one part at a time.
tip.stars: Every 10 stars you collect earn a free hint. Replay a level to raise its stars.
reminder.title: Today's Daily Hunt is waiting
reminder.body: Findo is hiding in a new crowd. One try, one leaderboard. Can you beat everyone?
reminder.ask.title: Want a daily reminder?
reminder.ask.body: We can let you know in the evening when there is a new Daily Hunt you haven't played. One notification a day at most, and you can turn it off in Settings.
reminder.blocked: Notifications are off for Findo. Turn them on in your phone's settings to get the reminder.
share.app: Have you played Findo? Find one girl hiding in a huge crowd. Come and try it!
share.level: I found Findo in {seconds}s on level {level} and got {stars} of 3 stars. Can you do better?
share.daily: I found Findo in today's Daily Hunt in {time}. Can you beat my time?
share.dailyMissed: Today's Daily Hunt beat me. Can you find Findo?
account.title: Account
account.pitch: Sign in with Google to keep your levels, stars, hints and purchases on every phone you play on.
account.welcome: Signed in. Your progress is saved to your account.
account.failed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
account.synced: Progress, hints and purchases are saved to your account.
account.delete.title: Delete your account?
account.delete.body: This deletes your saved progress from your account and removes you from the weekly and all-time leaderboards. Your progress on this phone stays. This cannot be undone.
